up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows where the pChEMBL value is non-null and the standard relation is '='. Filter for activities associated with the human single-protein target CHEMBL1914278 (G protein-activated inward rectifier potassium channel 4). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from the assays table), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1914278'
    AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    molecule_chembl_id,
    assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
